plans.name: Workout Plan #1
plans.tagline: The plan your personal trainer wrote for you: machines first, 4 sets of 12, 10, 10 and 8 reps.
plans.progression: When you hit every rep on all 4 sets, add one step of weight next time.

machine.name: Incline chest press machine
machine.kit: Selectorised incline press (Matrix style) or the plate-loaded incline press. If both are busy: Smith machine incline press.
machine.tip: Set the seat so the handles start just below shoulder height. Press up and slightly in, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.

videos.label: Incline machine chest press
How to do incline chest press machine

dumbbell.name: Incline dumbbell press
dumbbell.kit: Adjustable bench set to 30 to 45 degrees and two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Dumbbells start level with the upper chest. Press up and together without letting them clash.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell incline press
Incline dumbbell press

machine.name: Cable rope pullover (straight arm pulldown)
machine.kit: Cable machine, high pulley, rope attachment.
machine.tip: Stand facing the high pulley with arms nearly straight. Pull the rope down to your thighs in an arc and control it back up.

videos.label: How to do straight arm lat pulldowns
Straight arm pulldown

machine.note: Same movement pattern as Pull day exercise 2.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell pullover
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench and one dumbbell.
dumbbell.tip: Lie on the bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands. Lower it behind your head with a slight elbow bend, then pull it back over.

videos.label: Dumbbell pullover

machine.name: Lateral raise machine
machine.kit: Lateral raise machine (pads rest against the upper arms). If it is taken: cable lateral raise on the cable machine.
machine.tip: Set the seat so your shoulder joint lines up with the machine pivot. Push with the elbows, not the hands.

videos.label: Machine lateral raise
Ultra Series lateral raise
Cable lateral raises (if the machine is busy)

animation.note: Offline picture shows the cable version.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
dumbbell.kit: Two light dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Slight forward lean. Raise to shoulder height with the elbows leading, pause, lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do lateral raises
Lateral raise

machine.name: Seated chest press machine
machine.kit: Seated chest press (selectorised, converging arms).
machine.tip: Handles level with mid chest, shoulder blades back on the pad. Press without locking the elbows.

videos.label: How to do a seated chest press
How to use the chest press machine
Ultra Series converging chest press

dumbbell.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench and two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Feet flat, slight arch. Lower to chest level and press up and slightly in.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell bench press

machine.name: Cable chest fly (cable crossover)
machine.kit: Dual cable machine with the pulleys set high. If the cables are busy: the chest fly machine (pec deck).
machine.tip: Split stance, slight elbow bend. Bring the handles together in front of your chest and squeeze for a second.

videos.label: How to do a cable fly / cable crossover
How to use the chest fly machine

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell chest fly
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench and two light dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Keep a slight bend in the elbows. Open the arms until you feel a stretch, then bring the dumbbells back over the chest in an arc.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell chest fly

machine.name: Cable tricep pushdown
machine.kit: Cable machine, high pulley, rope or straight bar.
machine.tip: Elbows pinned to your sides. Push down until the arms are straight, then control the way up.

videos.label: How to do a tricep pushdown
Rope pushdown

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell tricep kickback
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell and a bench for support.
dumbbell.tip: Upper arm parallel to the floor and still. Extend the elbow until the arm is straight, squeeze, lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do a tricep kickback

machine.name: Cable rope overhead tricep extension
machine.kit: Cable machine, low or mid pulley, rope attachment. The tricep extension machine is an alternative.
machine.tip: Face away from the cable with the rope behind your head and elbows by your ears. Extend until the arms are straight.

videos.label: Rope overhead triceps extension
Cable overhead triceps extension

dumbbell.name: Overhead dumbbell tricep extension
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell, standing or seated.
dumbbell.tip: Hold the dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower it behind your head by bending only the elbows, then press up.

videos.label: How to do an overhead tricep extension

machine.name: Lat pulldown machine
machine.kit: Lat pulldown station with the wide bar.
machine.tip: Thigh pad snug, slight lean back. Pull the bar to the top of the chest with the elbows down and back.

videos.label: How to do a lat pulldown
Normal grip pulldown

dumbbell.name: Single arm dumbbell row
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell and a bench.
dumbbell.tip: Hand and knee on the bench, flat back. Pull the dumbbell to your hip and lower under control.

videos.label: How to do single arm dumbbell rows

machine.name: Straight arm cable pulldown
machine.kit: Cable machine, high pulley, rope or straight bar.
machine.tip: Arms nearly straight, hinge slightly at the hips. Pull the bar down to your thighs and feel the lats, then control it back up.

videos.label: How to do straight arm lat pulldowns
Straight arm pulldown

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell pullover
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench and one dumbbell.
dumbbell.tip: Same movement as the pulldown but lying down. Lower the dumbbell behind your head with a slight elbow bend, pull it back over the chest.

videos.label: Dumbbell pullover

machine.name: Seated cable row
machine.kit: Seated row station (low pulley) with the V handle.
machine.tip: Chest up. Pull the handle to your stomach, squeeze the shoulder blades, then let the arms straighten fully.

videos.label: How to do a seated cable row
How to use the seated row machine

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell bent over row
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back. Row both dumbbells to your hips.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell bent over row

machine.name: Diverging seated row (chest supported row machine)
machine.kit: Matrix Diverging Seated Row: chest pad and two independent arms. Any chest supported row machine works.
machine.tip: Chest on the pad, seat set so the handles sit at the bottom of the ribcage. Pull the elbows back and wide.

videos.label: Ultra Series diverging seated row
Chest supported row

dumbbell.name: Chest supported incline dumbbell row
dumbbell.kit: Incline bench at 30 to 45 degrees and two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Lie face down on the incline bench. Row both dumbbells to your hips and squeeze the shoulder blades.

videos.label: How to do an incline dumbbell row

machine.name: Cable face pull
machine.kit: Cable machine, pulley at face height, rope attachment.
machine.tip: Pull the rope towards your face with the hands finishing beside the ears and elbows high. Pause, then return slowly.

videos.label: How to do cable face pulls
Cable rope facepull

animation.note: Closest animation: cable rear delt row with rope.

dumbbell.name: Bent over dumbbell rear delt fly
dumbbell.kit: Two light dumbbells, standing or seated.
dumbbell.tip: Hinge forward with a slight elbow bend. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides level with the shoulders.

videos.label: How to do a rear delt fly
Bent lateral raise

machine.name: Cable bar curl
machine.kit: Cable machine, low pulley, straight or EZ bar. The bicep curl machine is an alternative.
machine.tip: Elbows fixed at your sides. Curl to shoulder height and lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do a cable curl
Cable EZ bar curl

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell bicep curl
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Palms up. Curl both dumbbells without swinging and lower for a count of three.

videos.label: How to double arm curl (dumbbell bicep curl)
How to do a single arm curl

barbell.name: Barbell curl (as written)
barbell.kit: Straight or EZ barbell.
barbell.tip: Shoulder width grip, elbows still. Curl to shoulder height.

videos.label: How to do a barbell bicep curl

machine.name: Cable rope hammer curl
machine.kit: Cable machine, low pulley, rope attachment.
machine.tip: Neutral grip on the rope, elbows by your sides. Curl up and squeeze.

videos.label: Rope twist curl
Cable rope biceps curl

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Palms facing each other. Curl without rotating the wrist.

videos.label: How to do hammer curls
Hammer curl

machine.name: Matrix Perfect Squat machine
machine.kit: Matrix Perfect Squat (VY-400): plate-loaded squat machine with shoulder pads and an angled foot plate. If your gym has none, use the hack squat machine.
machine.tip: Shoulders under the pads, feet mid plate about shoulder width. Release the safety, squat until the thighs pass parallel, drive up through the whole foot.

videos.label: Matrix Varsity Perfect Squat with sport stance
Perfect Squat machine (how to)
Hack squats on the hack squat machine (if no Perfect Squat)

animation.note: Closest animation: sled hack squat.

dumbbell.name: Goblet squat
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell.
dumbbell.tip: Hold the dumbbell against your chest. Elbows inside the knees at the bottom, chest up.

videos.label: How to do a goblet squat
Goblet squat when the machine is busy (Short)

machine.name: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
machine.kit: Smith machine with the bar set at mid thigh height.
machine.tip: Bar close to the legs, soft knees. Hinge at the hips until you feel the hamstrings stretch, then stand up by squeezing the glutes.

videos.label: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
Smith machine Romanian deadlift

animation.note: Closest animation: Smith machine deadlift.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Dumbbells slide down the front of the thighs as the hips go back. Flat back, stop at mid shin.

videos.label: Dumbbell stiff legged deadlift
Try dumbbell RDLs when the leg curl is busy (Short)

machine.name: Leg press machine
machine.kit: 45 degree plate-loaded leg press, or the seated leg press.
machine.tip: Feet shoulder width in the middle of the plate. Lower until the knees reach about 90 degrees and never let the lower back lift off the pad.

videos.label: How to do a 45 degree leg press
How to do a seated leg press
How to use the Magnum 45 degree leg press

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell squat
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells at your sides, or one held at the chest.
dumbbell.tip: Feet shoulder width. Sit back and down until the thighs are parallel, then drive up.

videos.label: Leg press taken? Grab a dumbbell and try this (Short)
How to do a goblet squat

machine.name: Smith machine reverse lunge
machine.kit: Smith machine with the bar on the upper back.
machine.tip: The bar path is fixed, so place the front foot where the knee tracks over the toes. Step back into the lunge and return.

videos.label: Smith machine reverse lunge
Smith machine reverse lunge

animation.note: Closest animation: Smith machine split squat.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells, or bodyweight to learn the pattern.
dumbbell.tip: Step back and lower the back knee towards the floor with the front shin vertical. Push through the front heel to stand.

videos.label: Reverse lunge (with dumbbells)
How to reverse lunge (bodyweight form)

machine.name: Leg curl machine (lying or seated)
machine.kit: Prone (lying) leg curl or seated leg curl machine.
machine.tip: Pad just above the heels, hips pressed into the bench. Curl all the way up and lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do a lying leg curl (prone leg curl)
How to use the prone leg curl machine

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell hamstring curl
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell and a flat bench.
dumbbell.tip: Lie face down with the dumbbell gripped between your feet. Curl it towards your glutes and lower under control.

videos.label: How to do dumbbell hamstring curls

machine.name: Leg extension machine
machine.kit: Leg extension machine.
machine.tip: Knee joint in line with the pivot, pad on the shins just above the ankles. Extend fully, pause, lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do a leg extension
Leg extension

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell leg extension
dumbbell.kit: A bench and one dumbbell gripped between the feet. PureGym suggests a goblet squat when the machine is busy.
dumbbell.tip: Sit on the end of the bench with the dumbbell between your feet. Extend the knees until the legs are straight, then lower slowly.

videos.label: Dumbbell leg extension
Goblet squat when the leg extension is busy (Short)

machine.name: Standing calf raise machine
machine.kit: Standing calf raise machine (shoulder pads). If none: Smith machine calf raise, or calf raises on the leg press.
machine.tip: Balls of the feet on the step. Lower the heels for a full stretch, rise as high as you can and pause.

videos.label: Calf machine
Hammer Strength Select standing calf raise
Calf raises on the Smith machine
Calf raises on the leg press

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell standing calf raise
dumbbell.kit: Dumbbells and a step or a weight plate.
dumbbell.tip: Dumbbells at your sides, balls of the feet on the edge of the step. Full stretch at the bottom and a pause at the top.

videos.label: Dumbbell standing calf raise
How to do a single leg calf raise

plans.name: Muscle Building PPL
plans.tagline: A PureGym trainer's plan for building muscle: barbells and dumbbells, 3 sets of 8 to 12, five lifts a day.
plans.source: The Best Gym Workout Plan For Gaining Muscle, push/pull/legs example Days 1 to 3, PureGym blog, by Spencer Cartwright, personal trainer at PureGym Bristol Brislington (adapted)
plans.progression: Start at a weight you can lift 8 times. Add reps each week until all 3 sets reach 12, then go up a step and build back up from 8.

machine.name: Smith machine bench press
machine.kit: Smith machine with a flat bench centred under the bar, so the bar comes down to your lower chest. If it is busy: the seated chest press machine.
machine.tip: Set the safety stops just below where the bar touches your chest. Lower to the lower chest with the elbows about 45 degrees out, then press straight up.

videos.label: Smith machine bench press

dumbbell.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench and two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Feet flat, slight arch. Lower to chest level and press up and slightly in.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell bench press

barbell.name: Barbell bench press
barbell.kit: Olympic flat bench station with a bar and collars. These usually have no safety arms, so ask for a spot, or put a flat bench inside a squat rack with the safety arms just below your chest as you lie on it.
barbell.tip: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades squeezed together, feet flat. Lower the bar to the lower chest, then press it back up over the shoulders.

videos.label: How to do a barbell bench press correctly
Medium grip bench press

machine.name: Smith machine seated shoulder press
machine.kit: Smith machine with an adjustable bench set almost upright under the bar, and the safety stops just below chin height. If the Smith is busy: the shoulder press machine.
machine.tip: Sit so the bar runs just in front of your face and starts at chin height. Press to just short of locking out, then lower back to the chin with control.

videos.label: Smith machine seated shoulder press
Smith machine seated overhead press

dumbbell.name: Standing dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells and a clear patch of floor. No bench needed.
dumbbell.tip: Stand tall with the abs and glutes braced so you do not lean back. Press from the shoulders to overhead and lower until the dumbbells are back at ear level.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell shoulder press
Standing dumbbell shoulder press

barbell.name: Barbell overhead press
barbell.kit: Squat rack with the hooks set at upper chest height and an Olympic barbell. Light sets can use a fixed weight barbell instead.
barbell.tip: Grip just outside the shoulders and brace hard. Move your head back as the bar passes your face, then bring it forward so the bar finishes over the middle of your feet.

videos.label: How to do a barbell shoulder press
How to do the military press

animation.note: The animation shows a wider grip, so keep your hands just outside your shoulders.

machine.name: Smith machine incline bench press
machine.kit: Smith machine with an adjustable bench at 30 to 45 degrees, placed so the bar lowers to your upper chest. If it is busy: the incline chest press machine.
machine.tip: Set the safety stops just below where the bar meets your upper chest. Twist the bar off the hooks, lower under control, then press straight up.

videos.label: Not got a spotter? Try the Smith machine (Short)
Smith machine incline press

dumbbell.name: Incline dumbbell press
dumbbell.kit: Adjustable bench set to 30 to 45 degrees and two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Dumbbells start level with the upper chest. Press up and together without letting them clash.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell incline press
Incline dumbbell press

barbell.name: Incline barbell bench press
barbell.kit: Olympic incline bench station with a bar and collars, with someone to spot you as it has no safety arms. Or an adjustable bench at 30 to 45 degrees inside a squat rack, with the safety arms just below your upper chest.
barbell.tip: Shoulder blades pinned into the bench. Lower the bar to the upper chest just under the collarbones, then press up over the shoulders.

videos.label: How to do a barbell incline bench press
Incline medium grip bench press

machine.name: Lateral raise machine
machine.kit: Lateral raise machine (pads rest against the upper arms). If it is taken: cable lateral raise on the cable machine.
machine.tip: Set the seat so your shoulder joint lines up with the machine pivot. Push with the elbows, not the hands.

videos.label: Machine lateral raise
Ultra Series lateral raise
Cable lateral raises (if the machine is busy)

animation.note: Offline picture shows the cable version.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
dumbbell.kit: Two light dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Slight forward lean. Raise to shoulder height with the elbows leading, pause, lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do lateral raises
Lateral raise

machine.name: Cable rope overhead tricep extension
machine.kit: Cable machine, low or mid pulley, rope attachment. The tricep extension machine is an alternative.
machine.tip: Face away from the cable with the rope behind your head and elbows by your ears. Extend until the arms are straight.

videos.label: Rope overhead triceps extension
Cable overhead triceps extension

dumbbell.name: Overhead dumbbell tricep extension
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell, standing or seated.
dumbbell.tip: Hold the dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower it behind your head by bending only the elbows, then press up.

videos.label: How to do an overhead tricep extension

machine.name: Smith machine deadlift
machine.kit: Smith machine with the safety stops set low, so the bar rests at about mid shin.
machine.tip: Feet hip width with the bar over the middle of the foot. Brace, push the floor away and stand tall, then lower with the hips going back first.

videos.label: Smith machine deadlift

animation.note: Offline pictures show the stiff legged Smith machine deadlift.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell deadlift
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells on the floor in front of your feet.
dumbbell.tip: Sit the hips back and bend the knees until the dumbbells touch the floor. Keep the back flat and stand up by driving through the whole foot.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell deadlift

animation.note: Offline pictures show the stiff legged version, so bend the knees more and lower to the floor.

barbell.name: Barbell deadlift
barbell.kit: Olympic barbell loaded with full size plates on the floor, on a lifting platform if your gym has one.
barbell.tip: Bar over the middle of the foot, shins close to it. Flat back and chest up, push the floor away and finish by squeezing the glutes.

videos.label: How to do a conventional deadlift correctly
Deadlift

machine.name: Smith machine bent over row
machine.kit: Smith machine with the bar set just below knee height.
machine.tip: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back. Row the bar to your lower ribs and keep the hips still.

videos.label: Smith machine row
How to do a Smith machine bent over row

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell bent over row
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back. Row both dumbbells to your hips.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell bent over row

barbell.name: Barbell bent over row
barbell.kit: Olympic barbell, or a fixed weight barbell from the rack.
barbell.tip: Overhand grip just wider than the shoulders. Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back, pull the bar to your lower ribs and lower it under control.

videos.label: How to do a barbell bent over row
Barbell bent over row

machine.name: Assisted pull up machine
machine.kit: Assisted pull up machine: kneel on the pad and pick the counterweight (more weight means more help). When 8 reps feel easy with little help, move to the bar with no assist, and if your gym has no machine, loop a band over the pull up bar.
machine.tip: Overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders, start from a dead hang. Drive the elbows down to your sides until your chin clears the handles, then lower slowly.

videos.label: How to use the assisted pull up machine
Assisted normal grip pullup

animation.note: Offline pictures show a band giving the help instead of the machine.

dumbbell.name: Single arm dumbbell row
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell and a bench.
dumbbell.tip: Hand and knee on the bench, flat back. Pull the dumbbell to your hip and lower under control.

videos.label: How to do single arm dumbbell rows

machine.name: Cable upright row
machine.kit: Cable machine, low pulley, straight bar or rope. The Smith machine works too if the cables are busy.
machine.tip: Hands about shoulder width apart and the bar close to your body. Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height, or a little lower if your shoulders pinch.

videos.label: How to do cable upright rows
Cable upright row

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell upright row
dumbbell.kit: Two light dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, palms facing you. Raise the elbows out and up to shoulder height with the weights close to your body, then lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do dumbbell upright rows
Dumbbell upright row

machine.name: Cable bar curl
machine.kit: Cable machine, low pulley, straight or EZ bar. The bicep curl machine is an alternative.
machine.tip: Elbows fixed at your sides. Curl to shoulder height and lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do a cable curl
Cable EZ bar curl

dumbbell.name: Single arm dumbbell curl
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells of the same weight, one in each hand.
dumbbell.tip: Elbows pinned to your sides. Curl one dumbbell up as the palm turns to face up, lower it for a count of three, then curl the other arm.

videos.label: How to do a single arm curl (bicep curl)

machine.name: Smith machine squat
machine.kit: Smith machine with the bar hooked at upper chest height and the safety stops set just below your lowest point.
machine.tip: Bar across the upper back, feet slightly in front of the bar. Twist it off the hooks, sit down until the thighs reach parallel, then drive up through the whole foot.

videos.label: Smith machine back squat
How to do a Smith machine back squat

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell squat
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells at your sides, or one held at the chest.
dumbbell.tip: Feet shoulder width. Sit back and down until the thighs are parallel, then drive up.

videos.label: Leg press taken? Grab a dumbbell and try this (Short)
How to do a goblet squat

barbell.name: Barbell back squat
barbell.kit: Squat rack with the hooks at upper chest height and the safety bars just below the bottom of your squat. Olympic bar (20 kg) and plates.
barbell.tip: Bar on the upper back, not the neck. Brace, sit the hips down between the heels with the knees following the toes until the thighs reach parallel, then stand up.

videos.label: How to do a barbell back squat
How to squat with a barbell properly

machine.name: Smith machine Bulgarian split squat
machine.kit: Smith machine with the safety stops set just below your lowest point and a flat bench about a long stride behind you for the back foot. The bar sits on your upper back.
machine.tip: Put the front foot far enough forward that its heel stays down. Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor, then push up through the front foot.

videos.label: Smith machine rear foot elevated split squat
How to: Smith machine Bulgarian split squat

animation.note: Keep your back foot up on the bench behind you.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench for the back foot and two dumbbells at your sides, or hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite the front leg.
dumbbell.tip: Slight forward lean with the front knee tracking over the toes. Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor and drive up through the front heel, then switch legs.

videos.label: Dumbbell rear foot elevated split squat
How to do Bulgarian split squats (bodyweight form)

animation.note: Keep your back foot up on the bench behind you.

machine.name: Leg press machine
machine.kit: 45 degree plate-loaded leg press, or the seated leg press.
machine.tip: Feet shoulder width in the middle of the plate. Lower until the knees reach about 90 degrees and never let the lower back lift off the pad.

videos.label: How to do a 45 degree leg press
How to do a seated leg press
How to use the Magnum 45 degree leg press

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell squat
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells at your sides, or one held at the chest.
dumbbell.tip: Feet shoulder width. Sit back and down until the thighs are parallel, then drive up.

videos.label: Leg press taken? Grab a dumbbell and try this (Short)
How to do a goblet squat

machine.name: Leg extension machine
machine.kit: Leg extension machine.
machine.tip: Knee joint in line with the pivot, pad on the shins just above the ankles. Extend fully, pause, lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do a leg extension
Leg extension

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell leg extension
dumbbell.kit: A bench and one dumbbell gripped between the feet. PureGym suggests a goblet squat when the machine is busy.
dumbbell.tip: Sit on the end of the bench with the dumbbell between your feet. Extend the knees until the legs are straight, then lower slowly.

videos.label: Dumbbell leg extension
Goblet squat when the leg extension is busy (Short)

machine.name: Seated calf raise machine
machine.kit: Seated calf raise machine with the knee pad resting on the lower thighs. If none: Smith machine seated calf raise, with a bench under the bar and a pad across the lower thighs.
machine.tip: Balls of the feet on the edge of the foot plate. Let the heels sink for a deep stretch, rise as high as you can and hold a second.

videos.label: Seated calf raise machine
Hammer Strength plate loaded seated calf

dumbbell.name: Seated dumbbell calf raise
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench or a box and two dumbbells. A weight plate under the balls of the feet gives a bigger stretch.
dumbbell.tip: Hold the dumbbells upright on your thighs just above the knees. Lower the heels all the way, then press up onto the toes and pause at the top.

videos.label: How to do a seated calf raise

animation.note: Offline pictures show one leg at a time; you can do both together.

plans.name: Barbell Strength PPL
plans.tagline: Heavy barbell lifts first with long rests, then lighter volume work. For a newer lifter who can still add weight most sessions.
plans.source: A Linear Progression Based PPL Program for Beginners, by u/Metallicdpa on r/Fitness, read from the archive copy on The Fitness Wiki (adapted)
plans.progression: Main lifts: add 2.5 kg a session (5 kg on the deadlift) while you hit every rep, and do as many reps as you can on the last set. The rest: reach the top of the range on every set, then add weight. The original swaps some main lifts every other session; this version keeps the bench press, deadlift and squat each time.

machine.name: Smith machine bench press
machine.kit: Smith machine with a flat bench centred under the bar, so the bar comes down to your lower chest. If it is busy: the seated chest press machine.
machine.tip: Set the safety stops just below where the bar touches your chest. Lower to the lower chest with the elbows about 45 degrees out, then press straight up.

videos.label: Smith machine bench press

dumbbell.name: Flat dumbbell bench press
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench and two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Feet flat, slight arch. Lower to chest level and press up and slightly in.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell bench press

barbell.name: Barbell bench press
barbell.kit: Olympic flat bench station with a bar and collars. These usually have no safety arms, so ask for a spot, or put a flat bench inside a squat rack with the safety arms just below your chest as you lie on it.
barbell.tip: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades squeezed together, feet flat. Lower the bar to the lower chest, then press it back up over the shoulders.

videos.label: How to do a barbell bench press correctly
Medium grip bench press

machine.name: Smith machine seated shoulder press
machine.kit: Smith machine with an adjustable bench set almost upright under the bar, and the safety stops just below chin height. If the Smith is busy: the shoulder press machine.
machine.tip: Sit so the bar runs just in front of your face and starts at chin height. Press to just short of locking out, then lower back to the chin with control.

videos.label: Smith machine seated shoulder press
Smith machine seated overhead press

dumbbell.name: Standing dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells and a clear patch of floor. No bench needed.
dumbbell.tip: Stand tall with the abs and glutes braced so you do not lean back. Press from the shoulders to overhead and lower until the dumbbells are back at ear level.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell shoulder press
Standing dumbbell shoulder press

barbell.name: Barbell overhead press
barbell.kit: Squat rack with the hooks set at upper chest height and an Olympic barbell. Light sets can use a fixed weight barbell instead.
barbell.tip: Grip just outside the shoulders and brace hard. Move your head back as the bar passes your face, then bring it forward so the bar finishes over the middle of your feet.

videos.label: How to do a barbell shoulder press

animation.note: The animation shows a wider grip, so keep your hands just outside your shoulders.

machine.name: Incline chest press machine
machine.kit: Selectorised incline press (Matrix style) or the plate-loaded incline press. If both are busy: Smith machine incline press.
machine.tip: Set the seat so the handles start just below shoulder height. Press up and slightly in, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.

videos.label: Incline machine chest press
How to do incline chest press machine

dumbbell.name: Incline dumbbell press
dumbbell.kit: Adjustable bench set to 30 to 45 degrees and two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Dumbbells start level with the upper chest. Press up and together without letting them clash.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell incline press
Incline dumbbell press

machine.name: Cable tricep pushdown
machine.kit: Cable machine, high pulley, rope or straight bar.
machine.tip: Elbows pinned to your sides. Push down until the arms are straight, then control the way up.

videos.label: How to do a tricep pushdown
Rope pushdown

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell tricep kickback
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell and a bench for support.
dumbbell.tip: Upper arm parallel to the floor and still. Extend the elbow until the arm is straight, squeeze, lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do a tricep kickback

machine.name: Lateral raise machine
machine.kit: Lateral raise machine (pads rest against the upper arms). If it is taken: cable lateral raise on the cable machine.
machine.tip: Set the seat so your shoulder joint lines up with the machine pivot. Push with the elbows, not the hands.

Ultra Series lateral raise

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell lateral raise

videos.label: How to do lateral raises
Lateral raise

machine.name: Cable lying tricep extension
machine.kit: Cable machine, low pulley, rope or EZ bar, with a flat bench in front of it. The tricep extension machine is an alternative.
machine.tip: Lie with your head towards the pulley and your arms pointing at the ceiling. Bend only the elbows to bring your hands back past your forehead, then straighten the arms.

videos.label: Cable lying triceps extension
Lying cable tricep extension

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench and two dumbbells. A mat on the floor works too, as in the PureGym clip.

videos.label: How to do skull crushers

barbell.name: EZ bar skull crusher
barbell.kit: EZ bar or straight barbell and a flat bench.
barbell.tip: Narrow grip, arms straight above your shoulders. Keep the upper arms still and bend only the elbows to lower the bar just behind the top of your head, then extend.

Barbell skullcrusher

machine.name: Smith machine deadlift
machine.kit: Smith machine with the safety stops set low, so the bar rests at about mid shin.
machine.tip: Feet hip width with the bar over the middle of the foot. Brace, push the floor away and stand tall, then lower with the hips going back first.

videos.label: Smith machine deadlift

animation.note: Offline pictures show the stiff legged Smith machine deadlift.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell deadlift
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells on the floor in front of your feet.
dumbbell.tip: Sit the hips back and bend the knees until the dumbbells touch the floor. Keep the back flat and stand up by driving through the whole foot.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell deadlift

animation.note: Offline pictures show the stiff legged version, so bend the knees more and lower to the floor.

barbell.name: Barbell deadlift
barbell.kit: Olympic barbell loaded with full size plates on the floor, on a lifting platform if your gym has one.
barbell.tip: Bar over the middle of the foot, shins close to it. Flat back and chest up, push the floor away and finish by squeezing the glutes.

videos.label: How to do a conventional deadlift correctly
Deadlift

machine.name: Assisted pull up machine
machine.kit: Assisted pull up machine: kneel on the pad and pick the counterweight (more weight means more help). When 8 reps feel easy with little help, move to the bar with no assist, and if your gym has no machine, loop a band over the pull up bar.
machine.tip: Overhand grip a little wider than the shoulders, start from a dead hang. Drive the elbows down to your sides until your chin clears the handles, then lower slowly.

videos.label: How to use the assisted pull up machine
Assisted normal grip pullup

animation.note: Offline pictures show a band giving the help instead of the machine.

dumbbell.name: Single arm dumbbell row
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell and a bench.
dumbbell.tip: Hand and knee on the bench, flat back. Pull the dumbbell to your hip and lower under control.

videos.label: How to do single arm dumbbell rows

machine.name: T bar row machine
machine.kit: Plate loaded T bar row machine: either the type with a chest pad, or the standing type, which works the lower back harder. If your gym has no T bar machine, use the landmine version.
machine.tip: Chest on the pad, or a flat back at about 45 degrees on the standing type. Pull the handles to your stomach with the elbows close and squeeze the shoulder blades.

videos.label: Chest supported T bar row tutorial
T bar row (standing machine)

animation.note: Offline pictures show the chest pad type.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell bent over row
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back. Row both dumbbells to your hips.

videos.label: How to do a dumbbell bent over row

barbell.name: T bar row (landmine)
barbell.kit: Olympic bar in the landmine attachment with plates on the free end. Hook a V handle under the bar next to the plates.
barbell.tip: Straddle the bar and hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back. Row the handle to your belly button, elbows driving back, then lower slowly.

videos.label: How to do T bar rows (landmine rows)

machine.name: Cable face pull
machine.kit: Cable machine, pulley at face height, rope attachment.
machine.tip: Pull the rope towards your face with the hands finishing beside the ears and elbows high. Pause, then return slowly.

videos.label: How to do cable face pulls
Cable rope facepull

animation.note: Closest animation: cable rear delt row with rope.

dumbbell.name: Bent over dumbbell rear delt fly
dumbbell.kit: Two light dumbbells, standing or seated.
dumbbell.tip: Hinge forward with a slight elbow bend. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides level with the shoulders.

videos.label: How to do a rear delt fly
Bent lateral raise

machine.name: Cable rope hammer curl
machine.kit: Cable machine, low pulley, rope attachment.
machine.tip: Neutral grip on the rope, elbows by your sides. Curl up and squeeze.

videos.label: Rope twist curl
Cable rope biceps curl

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.
dumbbell.tip: Palms facing each other. Curl without rotating the wrist.

videos.label: How to do hammer curls
Hammer curl

machine.name: Preacher curl machine
machine.kit: Biceps curl machine with an angled arm pad (Matrix style). If there is none, put a preacher bench in front of the low pulley and do a cable preacher curl.
machine.tip: Set the seat so your armpits rest on the top of the pad and the elbows line up with the pivot. Curl up and squeeze, then lower until the arms are almost straight.

dumbbell.name: Single arm dumbbell preacher curl
dumbbell.kit: Preacher bench, or an incline bench to lean over, and one dumbbell.
dumbbell.tip: Back of the upper arm flat on the pad. Lower until the arm is nearly straight, then curl up without lifting the elbow off the pad.

videos.label: Dumbbell single arm preacher curl

barbell.name: EZ bar preacher curl
barbell.kit: Preacher bench and an EZ bar, either a fixed weight one from the rack or one loaded with plates.
barbell.tip: Hold the angled inner grips with the upper arms flat on the pad. Lower under control to almost straight arms, then curl up without rocking forward.

videos.label: How to do preacher curls
EZ bar preacher curl

machine.name: Smith machine squat
machine.kit: Smith machine with the bar hooked at upper chest height and the safety stops set just below your lowest point.
machine.tip: Bar across the upper back, feet slightly in front of the bar. Twist it off the hooks, sit down until the thighs reach parallel, then drive up through the whole foot.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell squat
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells at your sides, or one held at the chest.
dumbbell.tip: Feet shoulder width. Sit back and down until the thighs are parallel, then drive up.

barbell.name: Barbell back squat
barbell.kit: Squat rack with the hooks at upper chest height and the safety bars just below the bottom of your squat. Olympic bar (20 kg) and plates.
barbell.tip: Bar on the upper back, not the neck. Brace, sit the hips down between the heels with the knees following the toes until the thighs reach parallel, then stand up.

videos.label: How to do a barbell back squat
How to squat with a barbell properly

machine.name: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
machine.kit: Smith machine with the bar set at mid thigh height.

animation.note: Closest animation: Smith machine deadlift.

dumbbell.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
dumbbell.kit: Two dumbbells.

videos.label: Dumbbell stiff legged deadlift
Try dumbbell RDLs when the leg curl is busy (Short)

machine.name: Smith machine front squat
machine.kit: Smith machine with the bar hooked at upper chest height and the safety stops set just below your lowest point.

dumbbell.name: Goblet squat

videos.label: How to do a goblet squat
Goblet squat when the machine is busy (Short)

barbell.name: Barbell front squat
barbell.kit: Squat rack with the hooks at upper chest height and the safety bars just below the bottom of your squat. Olympic bar (20 kg) and plates.
barbell.tip: Bar sits on the front of the shoulders with the elbows pointing forward and high. Keep the chest tall, squat to parallel or below, then drive straight up.

videos.label: How to do dumbbell hamstring curls

machine.name: Seated calf raise machine
machine.kit: Seated calf raise machine with the knee pad resting on the lower thighs. If none: Smith machine seated calf raise, with a bench under the bar and a pad across the lower thighs.
machine.tip: Balls of the feet on the edge of the foot plate. Let the heels sink for a deep stretch, rise as high as you can and hold a second.

dumbbell.kit: Flat bench or a box and two dumbbells. A weight plate under the balls of the feet gives a bigger stretch.

plans.name: Science Based PPL
plans.tagline: Exercises picked from research, with extra upper chest, glute and calf work, in 2 to 4 sets a lift.
plans.source: The Best "Push Pull Legs Routine" For Growth, Built With Science (Jeremy Ethier), 4 January 2020 (adapted)
plans.progression: When every set reaches the top of its range with good form, add the smallest step of weight.

machine.name: Smith machine incline bench press
machine.kit: Smith machine with an adjustable bench at 30 to 45 degrees, placed so the bar lowers to your upper chest. If it is busy: the incline chest press machine.

Leg press machine single leg calf raises (if the Smith machine is busy)

animation.note: The animation stands on the floor and the offline pictures use both legs: stand on a step or plate and work one leg at a time.

dumbbell.name: Single leg dumbbell calf raise
dumbbell.kit: One dumbbell and a step or weight plate next to a wall or rack you can hold for balance.
dumbbell.tip: Dumbbell in the hand on the working side, other hand on the wall. Drop the heel below the step, rise as high as you can and pause.

videos.label: How to do a single leg calf raise
No calf press machine? Grab a step (Short)

animation.note: Offline pictures show both legs; lift one foot and work one leg at a time.

machine.name: Seated calf raise machine
machine.kit: Seated calf raise machine with the knee pad resting on the lower thighs. If none: Smith machine seated calf raise, with a bench under the bar and a pad across the lower thighs.
machine.tip: Balls of the feet on the edge of the foot plate. Let the heels sink for a deep stretch, rise as high as you can and hold a second.

videos.label: Seated calf raise machine
Hammer Strength plate loaded seated calf

dumbbell.name: Seated dumbbell calf raise
dumbbell.kit: Flat bench or a box and two dumbbells. A weight plate under the balls of the feet gives a bigger stretch.
dumbbell.tip: Hold the dumbbells upright on your thighs just above the knees. Lower the heels all the way, then press up onto the toes and pause at the top.

videos.label: How to do a seated calf raise

animation.note: Offline pictures show one leg at a time; you can do both together.
